title: Well made spatula
text: Well made spatula. This is a well made, sturdy spatula.  The spatula is wide. Great for flipping big pancakes.  It's too big for my small pan, but works great for bigger pans and even better for scooping cookies off of the pan! I would buy this item and others from Amco

product_metadata.title: Amco - 5226933 Amco Stainless Steel/Heat-Resistant Nylon Slotted Turner, 13.25", Black
features: The slots on the turner head drain food when turning which is perfect for serving
The nylon head is heat-resistant up to 400°F (204° C)
The oversized handle is crafted from heavy duty, stainless steel and features a curved design for comfort and stability
Safe for use on all cookware, including non-stick
Dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up
description: Whether you’re cooking delicate foods like fish or crepes, or grilling hearty burgers or chops you can lift and flip them with ease with the Amcor Housework's Nylon Slotted Turner. The slots in the turner allow oils and other liquids to drain away from your food. Its nylon head is heat-resistant up to 400 degrees F, and is safe for all your cookware, even nonstick, while the handle is made of heavy-duty stainless steel and it’s dishwasher safe.
